lines: With it on, `import { defineEventHandler, getQuery } from 'h3'`, `useRuntimeConfig(event)`, `defineNitroPlugin`, `cachedEventHandler`, `useEvent`, auto-imports from subdirectories of `server/utils/` and handlers registered without a `route` all keep working. A handler that returns a string still sends it as `text/html` unless it sets a content type, and a handler that returns `null` still responds with `204 No Content`, or with the status it set.

+With `nitroLegacy.h3` on, Nuxt also removes any server alias that points `h3` at h3 v1, such as one a module sets so that `h3` resolves to the copy `nitropack` depends on, and reports it with `NUXT_B9015`. Nitro v3 can't run h3 v1, so with the alias removed, Nitro v2 code gets the h3 v1 helpers and other server code gets h3 v2.
Each part is a separate switch, so you can migrate one at a time:
